column1: # One row per event profile. Only hits whose RepeatMasker class/family matches rm_family_match are treated as candidate mobile elements
# (allow-list: everything else - Simple_repeat, Low_complexity, Satellite, Unknown, DNA, ERV1, ERVL... - is never promoted by name).
# profile          unique id of the event profile
# group            links to the group column of subfamilies.tsv
# rm_family_match  regex matched against col 11 (class/family) of the RepeatMasker .out
# enabled          yes | no   (profiles set to no are skipped)
# rule             named rule function: single_element | ltr_int_ltr | solo_ltr
# young_tiers      tiers from subfamilies.tsv that count as "young" for this profile (comma separated)
# evidence         evidence items besides "young", separated by ";". polya | tsd | structure
#                  confidence: high_confidence = young + ALL evidence items; probable = young + some but not all; low = the rest
#                  (with two evidence items "some but not all" = exactly one, matching the original definition)
# tsd_min/tsd_max  target site duplication length range (bp), searched in the reference flank window set in config.toml
# tsd_min_identity minimum identity of the two TSD copies (tolerates ONT errors; 1.0 = exact)
# min_cov          minimum fraction of the insertion covered by the primary element (after merging fragments)
# len_min/len_max  accepted insertion length range (bp), from the Sniffles call
# rule_params      key=value pairs separated by ";" read by the named rule
#   max_strand_switch        max strand changes allowed inside the element (L1: 1 for 5' inversion)
#   max_3end_left            max bases of the consensus 3' end missing; from the "(left)" column of the .out (3' end must be present)
#   allow_3prime_transduction  unique sequence between element and poly-A is accepted (lowers effective coverage)
#   absorb_inside_span       hit classes inside the span of the primary element that count as part of it (SVA components)
#   ltr_names / internal_names  repeat names for provirus parts (names are alias-aware, see subfamilies.tsv)
#   ltr_len                  accepted LTR length range, min-max bp
#   internal_min             minimum internal-region length (bp)
#   same_orientation         both LTRs must have the same orientation
#   ltr_min_identity         minimum identity between the two LTR copies in the insertion (young proviruses have near-identical LTRs)
profile
Alu
column15: full length ~300 bp; poly-A at the 3' end of the element (on C hits it appears as poly-T at the 5' side of the insertion); plain Alu (generic tier) is judged by divergence only

column1: L1
column15: 5' truncation is normal, so only the 3' end is required; 5' inversion allowed; check ORF2/3'UTR hits in the .out when merging

column1: SVA
column15: composite element: Alu-like and VNTR pieces inside the SVA span count as SVA, not as separate Alu or artifact hits; SVA_A to SVA_C are not young

column1: HERVK_provirus
column15: structure = two LTR5 copies in the same orientation flanking an internal region; only LTR5_Hs counts as young, so LTR5A/LTR5B proviruses end up low; HERVK-int was not observed in the first dataset, so any internal-region hit (or unannotated internal sequence) is accepted; no poly-A expected

column1: HERVK_solo_ltr
column15: disabled by default; a lone LTR insertion may come from recombination of an existing provirus and is weaker evidence of a new retrotransposition; enable if you want these calls
